experiment: Eighteen full-scale vacuum-chamber gravity load tests (nine single-span base tests and nine three-span confirming tests) of Z- and C-purlin supported standing seam roof systems with different panel, clip, bracing and purlin-orientation configurations were loaded to failure, and the measured three-span strengths were compared with predictions of the base test method.
title: A Method for Determining the Strength of Z- and C-Purlin Supported Standing Seam Roof Systems (MBMA Report 8903)

variables.definition: Label identifying each test set or individual test (purlin type - bracing - panel/clip - number of spans, with "(0)" denoting opposed flanges).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; Table 3.1 p.21; Tables 3.2/3.3 pp.23,25; Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29; Table S1
variables.name: Test identification
variables.note: In Tables 3.2/3.3 the designation is printed only on the first row of each span pair.

variables.definition: Position of the individual purlin line within the test setup (ridge, intermediate, eave) and the bay (east, center, west) to which the measured cross-section values apply.
variables.evidence: Column headers of the unnumbered appendix cross-section geometry tables, pp.37-118
variables.name: Purlin line location
variables.note: Appears as the column headings of the geometry tables rather than as a data column.

variables.definition: Cold-formed cross-section shape of the purlin, Z-section or C-section, as stated for each test configuration.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; Table S1
variables.name: Purlin section type

variables.definition: Lateral bracing arrangement provided to the purlins (rafters/supports only, or rafters plus third points).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; Table S1
variables.name: Bracing arrangement

variables.definition: Standing seam roof panel profile family used in the test, rib type or pan type.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; Table S1
variables.name: Roof panel type

variables.definition: Type of standing seam clip connecting panel to purlin: one-piece fixed or two-piece sliding.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; Table S1
variables.name: Clip type

variables.definition: Whether the purlin top flanges all face the same direction or are opposed in the test assembly.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11
variables.name: Purlin orientation
variables.note: Opposed configuration also flagged by "(0)" in the test designation.

variables.definition: Total overlap length of the lapped purlins at the interior rafter location in the three-span confirming test.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.11; repeated in a Table S1 header note
variables.name: Lap length at interior rafter

variables.definition: Measured base metal thickness of the purlin material, from tensile coupons cut from the web and from the appendix cross-section measurements.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.21; appendix cross-section tables; Table S1
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: Coupon thickness in Table 3.1 differs slightly from the measured section thickness in Table S1.

variables.definition: Average measured yield stress of two standard ASTM tensile coupons cut from the purlin web, also listed on each appendix cross-section table and used in the capacity calculations.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.21; Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29; appendix geometry tables; Table S1
variables.name: Yield stress
variables.note: Z-R-P/S-1 is printed as 62.45 ksi in Table 3.1 but 67.45 ksi in the appendix; Tables 4.1/4.2 use a single (three-span coupon) value per test set.

variables.definition: Average measured ultimate tensile strength of two coupons cut from the purlin web.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.21
variables.name: Tensile strength

variables.definition: Average measured percent elongation of two standard tensile coupons.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.21
variables.name: Coupon elongation

variables.definition: Number of spans in the test setup, one for the single-span base test and three (two in the reference tests) for the confirming test.
variables.evidence: Tables 3.2/3.3 pp.23,25; Table S1
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly (two for base tests, three or four for confirming tests).
variables.evidence: Table S1
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Span length of each span of the test assembly as printed (25 ft 0 in. for base tests, 23 ft 6 in. for three-span tests).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column span_ft and header note
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Direction of the applied vacuum-chamber load; gravity for all tests in this program.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction and header note
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Measured ultimate uniform load per purlin line at failure, obtained from vacuum-chamber pressure measured with a U-tube manometer; reported both for single-span base tests (wu) and for the multi-span confirming tests.
variables.evidence: Tables 3.2/3.3 pp.23,25; Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29 (wu base and wu 3-span/2-span columns); Table S1
variables.name: Measured failure load
variables.note: Base-test and confirming-test values appear as separate columns in Tables 4.1-4.3; small print discrepancies exist between the summary tables and the appendix sheets.

variables.definition: Observed mode of failure recorded during the test: LM (failure after considerable lateral movement), LB (local buckling of lip, flange or web) or BR (failure of a lateral brace-to-purlin connection).
variables.evidence: Tables 3.2/3.3 pp.23,25 with abbreviation notes; Table S1
variables.name: Failure mode
variables.note: Appendix sheet for Z-T-P/S-3 calls the BR failure "lateral torsional buckling".

variables.definition: Maximum simple-span moment of the single-span base test corresponding to the measured base test failure load.
variables.evidence: Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29 (mus_kip_in); Table S1 failure_moment_as_printed
variables.name: Base test failure moment
variables.note: Printed only for the single-span base tests; blank for multi-span tests.

variables.definition: 1986 AISI allowable flexural capacity of the fully braced (constrained bending) purlin multiplied by 1.67, computed from the measured geometry and yield stress.
variables.evidence: Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29 (maisi_kip_in); AISI row of each appendix geometry table
variables.name: AISI flexural capacity x 1.67
variables.note: Printed ridge value 119.9 kip-in. for Z-T-R/S-1 is inconsistent with the eave value 198.9 kip-in.

variables.definition: Maximum negative (support) moment from a stiffness analysis of the continuous test assembly under a uniform load of 100 plf.
variables.name: Negative moment at 100 plf

variables.definition: Maximum positive (span) moment from a stiffness analysis of the continuous test assembly under a uniform load of 100 plf.
variables.name: Positive moment at 100 plf

variables.definition: Continuous-span failure load predicted by the base test method assuming the negative moment region (fully braced AISI capacity) controls.
variables.name: Predicted load, negative moment control
variables.note: Z-T-P/F value printed 332.2 plf here but 329.7 plf in Appendix B.5.

variables.definition: Continuous-span failure load predicted by the base test method assuming the positive moment region (base test moment Mus) controls.
variables.name: Predicted load, positive moment control

variables.definition: Governing predicted continuous-span failure load, taken as the smaller of the negative- and positive-moment controlled predictions.
variables.name: Predicted failure load

variables.definition: Ratio of the measured multi-span failure load to the base-test-method predicted failure load.
variables.evidence: Tables 4.1-4.3 pp.27-29; Table S1 actual_to_predicted_load_ratio
variables.name: Actual to predicted load ratio
variables.note: Ratios 0.61 (Z-R-R/S) and 0.84 (Z-T-P/S) were excluded by the authors as premature failures.

variables.definition: Measured out-to-out total depth of the purlin cross-section.
variables.evidence: Row "Total Depth (inches)" of each appendix geometry table; depth_in column of Table S1
variables.name: Total purlin depth
variables.note: Range of measured depths given in Table S1 where purlins in one test differed.

variables.definition: Measured vertical dimension of the stiffening lip on the top flange of the purlin.
variables.evidence: Row "TOP Vertical Lip Dimension (inches)" of each appendix geometry table
variables.name: Top lip dimension

variables.definition: Measured angle between the top flange stiffening lip and the flange (90 degrees for the C-sections).
variables.evidence: Row "TOP Lip Angle (degree)" of each appendix geometry table
variables.name: Top lip angle

variables.definition: Measured width of the top flange of the purlin.
variables.evidence: Row "TOP Flange Width (inches)" of each appendix geometry table
variables.name: Top flange width

variables.definition: Measured vertical dimension of the stiffening lip on the bottom flange of the purlin.
variables.evidence: Row of the appendix geometry tables cited in the Z-R-R/F-1 note ("eave BOTTOM vertical lip dimension ... 0.8253 in."), p.47
variables.name: Bottom lip dimension
variables.note: Printed table value for Z-R-R/F-1 eave differs from the sketch.

variables.definition: Measured angle between the bottom flange stiffening lip and the flange.
variables.evidence: Companion row to the TOP Lip Angle row in the appendix geometry tables
variables.name: Bottom lip angle
variables.note: Row label not shown in the extracted sample rows; inferred from the top/bottom pairing of the geometry tables.

variables.definition: Measured width of the bottom flange of the purlin.
variables.evidence: Row of the appendix geometry tables cited in the Z-R-P/F-1 and Z-R-P/F-3 notes ("BOTTOM flange width ... 2.8875 in."), pp.56, 61
variables.name: Bottom flange width
variables.note: Some printed values differ from the accompanying sketches.

variables.definition: Gross moment of inertia of the purlin cross-section computed from the measured dimensions.
variables.evidence: Row cited in the Z-R-R/F-3 note ("gross moment of inertia ... 8.31 in.4"), p.51; appears in all appendix geometry tables
variables.name: Gross moment of inertia
variables.note: West-bay intermediate value for Z-R-R/F-3 is inconsistent with the other values in the row.
